newsitem.title: GERMANY: VW's Piech sees pickup in demand recently.
newsitem.headline: VW's Piech sees pickup in demand recently.

text.p: Volkswagen AG management board chairman Ferdinand Piech said on Tuesday that the German carmaker has "witnessed a slight pick-up" in demand for cars in the German market in the last few weeks.
Piech said the pick-up could stimulate German sales of VW vehicles in the second half of 1996.
"For the year as a whole we expect that our profit will, as planned, be higher than that of last year," Piech told a news conference to introduce the new Passat vehicle.
Last year Volkswagen, Europe's largest car maker, reported a net profit of 336 million marks on sales of 88.1 billion marks.
